_comment: Dated price snapshot for scripts/cost_report.py. Prices change; this file is the reason the number in docs/costs.md can be dated and re-checked. Copy it, edit it, pass your own with --prices.

qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b._note: embedding endpoint; no completion tokens are billed

fallback_models._note: An embed cell is a code cell calling an embedding endpoint. It reports tokens_prompt in its hop header but no model id -- the model lives in its own payload. Attribute it here, or its tokens land in the 'unknown' bucket and are excluded from the total.
